concerns.text: Task T047 (Reproducibility Run) is marked as incomplete/unchecked. The Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) mandates that 'Every result reported... MUST be reproducible by re-running...'. Without the completion of T047, the project cannot claim to satisfy the non-negotiable reproducibility requirement, effectively weakening the constitutional constraint.

Task T051 (Final State Registry Update) is marked as incomplete. Constitution Principle V (Versioning Discipline) requires 'Every artifact under this project carries a content hash' and updates to the state YAML. T051 is the designated task for this final update; its incompletion means the project artifacts lack the required versioning discipline, violating the constitution.

Task T057 (VIF Analysis) is marked as rejected/incomplete. The Plan explicitly mandates 'Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) analysis to detect multicollinearity' to ensure the statistical validity of the GLMM model. The absence of this task's deliverable (vif_report.json) means the statistical rigor required by the plan and FR-005 (regression analysis reliability) is not preserved.

Task T062 (Data Consistency Check) is marked as incomplete. Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) requires that 'No data may be modified in place; every transformation MUST produce a new file with a documented derivation' and implies traceability. T062 is the specific mechanism to verify that every raw workflow has corresponding processed logs and results. Its absence leaves the data hygiene and traceability constraints unverified.

Task T063 (Memory Usage Profiling) is marked as incomplete. Constitution Principle VII (Resource-Constrained Execution Fidelity) mandates adherence to the '7GB RAM limit'. T063 is the specific task to verify this constraint via profiling. Without its completion, the project cannot assert compliance with the resource constraints defined in the constitution.
